description: North Central Province - Declaring that the 04 th Session of the 06th Provincial Council ended on 21.12.2015 & the 05th Session Shall meet on 18.02.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is a declaration by the Provincial Governor regarding the conclusion of one session and the convening of the next session of the Provincial Council. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes at the provincial level, specifically covering the scheduling and meeting of a legislative body, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters related to electoral processes and legislative sessions.
